title: 第5章 挫折第6章 峰回路转
content_zh:
第五章 挫折
比赛还在继续，但是迪甘已经不在场上了，坐在替补席的角落里，他现在的模样就是一个十足的失败者。
上半场结束之前的那个角球，他最终还是没能顶.进去，足球只是稍稍高出了横梁，他也错过了一次最好的机会。
原本迪甘还想着下半场他肯定还有机会，因为他已经渐渐找到了感觉，和这具身体的磨合也越来越熟练了，但是很可惜，塔索蒂不想给他机会了。
中场休息的时候，塔索蒂当着一帮队友的面，把迪甘批得一无是处，就差指着他的鼻子，说他是个垃圾，是个废物了。
迪甘想要反驳，但最终还是忍住了，他知道今天这场戏他演砸了，要是再顶撞塔索蒂的话，只怕就算有卡卡罩着，他在米兰内洛也没了存身之地。
而且迪甘很清楚，意大利教练的脑袋就是保守的代名词，虽然意大利这个国家很艺术，但是在对待足球的时候，他们甚至比德国人更加腔调纪律，不守规矩，不听指挥的人，他们是不需要的。
最为可笑的是，下半场一开始，没了迪甘这个搅局的，AC米兰很快就扳平了比分，三分钟之后，马特里再入一球实现了反超，而顶替他出场的青年队队长罗马里格诺的表现也十分出色，比赛结束之后，还在后场一记长传，助攻博列洛完成了帽子戏法。
最终这场热身赛，AC米兰11：1大获全胜，但是这场胜利和迪甘没有任何关系，他留给人们的除了一次糟糕的失误之外，就只有像没头苍蝇似的一样乱跑，至于他的两次攻门，也都在他之前拙劣的表演之下，被掩盖了。
“嘿！大个子！还是去给卡卡拎球鞋吧！那个活儿更适合你！”
“大个子！你简直是逊毙了！回家躲进妈妈的怀里哭吧！”
迪甘离开球场的时候，一些球迷对着他大肆嘲笑，完全没有因为他是卡卡的弟弟就爱屋及乌。
迪甘紧紧的攥着拳头，额头上青筋迸现，他很愤怒，但是他没理由发泄出来，因为他自己也知道，刚才的比赛，他的表现究竟有多垃圾。
“罗德！别放在心上，你知道的，他们并没有恶意！”潘卡罗追了过来，拍着迪甘的肩膀说道，“他们只是希望你能做的更好，毕竟你是里卡多的弟弟！”
卡卡的弟弟！
难道就因为是卡卡的弟弟，老子就要像个小丑一样的按照别人的剧本去演戏，去取悦他们吗？
迪甘很想咆哮出来，但他还是忍住了，没有恶意，迪甘真的很想大笑一场，这都不算恶意的话，那什么算？
要上来揪着我的衣服，打脸吗？
现在这算什么？
挫折吗？

懦夫面对挫折的时候是怎么选择的？
退却吗？
将脑袋伸进裤裆里，去装鸵鸟，一辈子承认自己是个十足的失败者，走在大街上只敢低头扶着墙，连句硬气的话都不敢说，对别人的嘲讽只能用精神胜利法。
这就是那些人希望的。
迪甘要妥协吗？
开什么玩笑？
挫折算什么？
输了再赢回来也就是了，嘲笑算什么，这些人的嘲笑声越大，以后抽他们的脸，就会更用力。
任世间谤我，欺我，辱我，笑我，轻我，贱我，恶我，骗我，又如何处之？
暂且忍他，让他，由他，避他，耐他，敬他，不要理他，再过几年，你再看他。
想到这里，迪甘的心突然安静了下来，他高昂着头，迎着那些球迷的嘲笑，就好像是一个胜利者一样，从他们的面前经过。
“那家伙傻了吗？”
“难道他听不懂意大利语，以为我们在夸奖他！？”
“这家伙简直蠢透了，有这么一个弟弟是卡卡的悲哀！”
迪甘去更衣室换了衣服，期间没有和任何人说一句话，他就好像隐形了一样，洗澡，换衣服，然后离开。
到了停车场的时候，迪甘看见了卡卡，他正站在那辆路虎的旁边，显然是在等着他。
迪甘很坦然的走了过去，从容的一笑：“来看我的比赛！？”
卡卡的表情显得有些尴尬，他想要安慰迪甘，可是却不知道该说什么好，就这么站着，好一会儿才说：“罗德！我知道那不是你真正的实力！”
“不！那就是我的实力！”
卡卡一愣，显得很意外，紧接着就皱眉道：“你这么说是打算要自暴自弃吗？罗德！昨天你不是这样说的，你说过要超越我的！”

迪甘个为目标的！我说这就是我真正的实力，那是因为，我不习惯待在后面，做一个专干脏活，累活的防守者，但是很显然，塔索蒂教练并不这么认为，或许他认为我的体形何以帮着菲奥里挡住球门！”
卡卡没理会迪甘的玩笑，疑惑道：“罗德！可是你以前一直都是这个位置的，我是说从圣保罗开始，而且你在中后卫的位置上干得一直都很出色。”
迪甘已经准备上车了：“我现在想要改变一下，好了！我不想继续这个话题了，我记得今天不只是你来了，爸爸呢！？”
卡卡愣住了，没等他回话，迪甘就已经钻进了车里，汽车发动机一阵轰鸣，转眼间就开走了，卡卡皱着眉，懊恼的不知道该怎么办了，他隐约感觉到家人今天似乎是伤了迪甘的心。
回到家里，迪甘默不作声的进屋，准备上楼，博斯克和西蒙尼就在客厅里坐着，卡罗琳则一脸担心的看着迪甘。
“放心，不用为我担心，我很好！”
博斯克这个时候站了起来，道：“罗德里格！我想我们需要谈谈了！”
迪甘一耸肩膀，道：“谈什么，我的未来，没错，你是我的父亲，这个是你应该关心的事情！”
博斯克的脸色并不好看，今天在看台上，那些球迷说的话，他都听见了，这让他感觉到莱特这个姓氏都受到了侮辱。
“罗德！我不想评价你今天在球场上的表现，因为那实在是糟透了，我现在只想对你说，或许你应该寻找另一条出路！”
迪甘听到这话，不知道为什么，他突然就爆发了，巨大的愤怒燃烧了他的理智，让他的胸腔几乎都要炸开。
“寻找另一条出路，你应该直接说，算了吧！罗德！你不该再踢足球了，就算你踢上一百年，你也不会有任何作为，这是一个父亲应该对怀揣着梦想的孩子说的话吗？”
西蒙尼也站了起来，道：“罗德！你的爸爸只是想要关心你，别用这样的与其对他说话！”
“是吗？”迪甘的眼神带着嘲弄，道，“那我该怎么说？谢谢他让我认清了自己，我真该感谢你们，在比赛结束之前就离开了，因为那样，我就不用在家人的面前出丑了，如果你还希望我能在一条正确的路上走得更远，请给我鼓励，当然现在的漠不关心也挺好，至少这样我就不用背负的太多了！”
迪甘说完之后，转身就上楼去了，也不理会家人那惊愕的眼神，说出这样的话来，迪甘都觉得有些孩子气，不过今天博斯克的表现确实是伤到了他的心。
可是不管怎样，失败就是失败了，转天他就得到了消息，里米尼租借球员的名单上没有他，他们选中了马特里，以及下半场顶替了他位置的罗马里格诺。
听到这个消息的时候，迪甘甚至都不觉得怎样，里米尼，那么一个小俱乐部，是藏不住真龙的。
content_en:
Chapter 5 Frustration
The game is still going on, but Deegan is no longer on the court. Sitting in the corner of the bench, he looks like a complete loser now.
He ultimately failed to take the corner kick before the end of the first half. The football was only slightly higher than the crossbar, and he also missed his best opportunity.
Originally, Deegan thought that he would still have a chance in the second half, because he had gradually found the feeling and became more and more familiar with this body, but unfortunately, Tassotti did not want to give him a chance.
At halftime, Tassotti criticized Deegan in front of a group of teammates, pointing at his nose and saying that he was garbage and a waste.
Deegan wanted to refute, but in the end he held back. He knew that he had failed in today's scene. If he contradicted Tassotti again, he would have no place in Milanello even with Kaka covering him.
And Deegan knows very well that the Italian coach's head is synonymous with conservatism. Although Italy is a very artistic country, when it comes to football, they are even more disciplined than the Germans. People who do not follow the rules and do not follow orders are not needed.
The most ridiculous thing is that at the beginning of the second half, without Deegan as a spoiler, AC Milan quickly equalized the score. Three minutes later, Matri scored another goal to achieve the lead. The youth team captain Romario who replaced him also performed very well. After the game, he made a long pass from the backcourt and assisted Borriello to complete the hat trick.
In the final warm-up match, AC Milan won 11:1, but this victory had nothing to do with Deegan. Apart from one bad mistake, all he left to people was running around like a headless fly. As for his two goals, they were covered up by his previous poor performance.
"Hey! Big man! It's better to carry Kaka's sneakers! That job is more suitable for you!"
"Big man! You are so inferior! Go home and hide in your mother's arms to cry!"
When Deegan left the stadium, some fans laughed at him, not because he was Kaka's younger brother.
Deegan clenched his fists tightly, and veins popped out on his forehead. He was very angry, but he had no reason to vent it out, because he himself also knew how rubbish his performance was in the game just now.
"Rhode! Don't take it to heart, you know, they don't mean any harm!" Pancaro chased after him, patted Deegan on the shoulder and said, "They just hope you can do better, after all, you are Ricardo's younger brother!"
Kaka’s younger brother!
Just because he is Kaka's younger brother, do I have to act like a clown and follow other people's scripts to please them?
Deegan wanted to roar, but he held it back. There was no malice. Deegan really wanted to laugh. If this wasn't considered malicious, then what was?
Are you going to come up and grab my clothes and slap me in the face?
What does that count now?
Frustration?
How do cowards choose when faced with setbacks?
Back off?
Put your head in your crotch to pretend to be an ostrich, and admit that you are a complete loser all your life. When walking on the street, you only dare to lower your head and hold on the wall. You don't even dare to say a strong word. You can only use the method of spiritual victory to ridicule others.
That's what those people want.
Is Deegan going to compromise?
Are you kidding me?
What’s a setback?
It's just a matter of losing and winning again. It's nothing to laugh at. The louder these people laugh, the harder they will be slapped in the face in the future.
If the world slanders me, bullies me, humiliates me, laughs at me, belittles me, despises me, hates me, and deceives me, how should I deal with it?
For the time being, tolerate him, let him, let him, avoid him, be patient with him, respect him, ignore him, and see him again in a few years.
Thinking of this, Deegan's heart suddenly calmed down. He held his head high and faced theThe jeers of some fans passed by them as if they were a victor.
"Is that guy stupid?"
"Does he not understand Italian and think we are complimenting him!?"
"This guy is so stupid. It's Kaka's tragedy to have such a younger brother!"
Deegan went to the locker room to change clothes. He didn't say a word to anyone during this period. He seemed to be invisible. He took a shower, changed clothes, and then left.
When he arrived at the parking lot, Deegan saw Kaka. He was standing next to the Land Rover, obviously waiting for him.
Deegan walked over calmly and smiled calmly: "Come to see my game!?"
Kaka's expression seemed a little embarrassed. He wanted to comfort Deegan, but he didn't know what to say. He just stood there for a while before saying: "Rhode! I know that is not your real strength!"
"No! That's my strength!"
Kaka was stunned for a moment, looking very surprised, and then frowned and said: "Are you planning to give up on yourself? Rhodes! That's not what you said yesterday. You said you would surpass me!"
Degan is the target! I said this is my real strength, that's because I'm not used to staying behind and being a defender who does dirty work, but obviously, Coach Tassotti doesn't think so. Maybe he thinks my body shape helps Fiori block the goal! "
Kaka ignored Deegan's joke and said doubtfully: "Rhode! But you have always been in this position before, I mean starting from Sao Paulo, and you have always done an excellent job at the central defender position. "
Deegan was ready to get in the car: "I want to change something now, okay! I don’t want to continue this topic. I remember that it’s not just you who is here today, dad is too! ? "
Kaka was stunned. Before he could reply, Deegan had already gotten into the car. The car engine roared and drove away in a blink of an eye. Kaka frowned and was so upset that he didn't know what to do. He vaguely felt that his family seemed to have broken Deegan's heart today.
Back home, Deegan entered the house silently and prepared to go upstairs. Bosque and Simone were sitting in the living room, while Caroline looked at Deegan with a worried look.
"Don't worry, don't worry about me, I'm fine! "
Bosque stood up at this time and said: "Rodrigo! I think we need to talk! "
Deegan shrugged his shoulders and said: "What are you talking about? My future, yes, you are my father, this is something you should be concerned about! "
Bosque's face was not good-looking. He heard everything the fans said in the stands today, which made him feel that the surname Wright had been insulted.
"Rhode! I don't want to comment on your performance on the court today, because it was really terrible. I just want to say to you now, maybe you should find another way out! "
When Deegan heard this, he didn't know why, but he burst out suddenly. The huge anger burned his reason and made his chest almost explode.
“Looking for another way out, you should just say, forget it! Rod! You shouldn't play football anymore. Even if you play for a hundred years, you won't achieve anything. Is this what a father should say to a child with dreams? "
Simeone also stood up and said: "Rhodes! Your dad just wants to care about you, don't talk to him like that! "
"Yeah? Deegan's eyes were mocking and he said, "Then what should I say?" Thank you for letting me recognize myself. I really should thank you for leaving before the end of the game, because that way, I don’t have to make a fool of myself in front of my family. If you still hope that I can go further on the right path, please encourage me. Of course, it’s good to be indifferent now, at least this way I don’t have to bear too much! "
After Deegan finished speaking, he turned around and went upstairs, ignoring the shocked eyes of his family and saidDeegan felt a little childish when he said such words, but Bosque's performance today really hurt his heart.
But no matter what, failure is failure, and the next day he got the news that Rimini did not have him on the list of loan players. They selected Matri and Romario, who took his place in the second half.
When he heard the news, Deegan didn't even think anything of it. Rimini, such a small club, couldn't hide the real dragon.
